title: UAE Ministry of Social Affairs Opens Assistive Technology Center for Persons with Disabilities
summary: The UAE Ministry of Social Affairs has inaugurated a new center dedicated to providing assistive technology services and support for individuals with disabilities.
body:
The UAE Ministry of Social Affairs has inaugurated a new center dedicated to providing assistive technology services and support for individuals with disabilities.
